newsitem.title: USA: Northwest lowers Colorado Springs fares.
newsitem.headline: Northwest lowers Colorado Springs fares.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp said Monday it will offer special fares to Colorado Springs, Colorado, for travel between January 20 and April 5.

The fares range from $138 round-trip from Milwaukee and San Antonio, to $198 from Atlanta and Detroit, to $258 from Miami and Boston, Northwest said. The carrier said tickets must be purchased by midnight January 10 and they must be bought at least 14 days before the first leg of travel. Other restrictions also apply, Northwest said.
Northwest last week matched a winter fare sale launched by the nation's other major carriers that slashed ticket prices by as much as 40 percent.
The company's stock was up 3/4 Monday at 39-3/4.
